channel.title: Duke Clinical Microbiology – Announcements
channel.description: Recent announcements and updates from the Duke Clinical Microbiology Laboratory

item.title: 8/17/2026: Urine RT-PCR test (LAB3607) to the BKR INPATIENT/OUTPATIENT Rubella (German Measles) Order Panel
item.description: Beginning Monday, August 17, 2026, the Duke Clinical Microbiology Laboratory will add an additional option for Urine RT-PCR test (LAB3607) to the BKR INPATIENT/OUTPATIENT Rubella (German Measles) Order Panel to improve sensitivity for suspected acute/active Rubella disease. Current options for nasopharyngeal RT-PCR and serum IgM within the order panel remain unchanged.

item.title: 6/01/2026: Culture, Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) w Gram Stain (LAB268)
item.description: Beginning on Monday, June 1, 2026, Duke Clinical Microbiology will update source options for Culture, Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) w Gram Stain (LAB268). Additionally, Community/Perinatal Meningitis PCR Panel and Culture, CSF (LAB9523) will now include the source “Lumbar Puncture”, rather than the less descript “Cerebrospinal Fluid.”

item.title: 3/30/2026: Trichomonas vaginalis, Qualitative PCR (LAB3471)
item.description: Beginning Monday, March 30, 2026, the Duke Clinical Microbiology Laboratory will offer a new Trichomonas vaginalis, Qualitative PCR (LAB3471) test, and will no longer offer the combined Trichomonas vaginalis and Mycoplasma genitalium, Qualitative PCR test. There will be no change to other related, currently available tests: Sexually Transmitted Infection (STI) Panel, Qualitative PCR (LAB3480), and Chlamydia trachomatis and Neisseria gonorrhoeae, Qualitative PCR (LAB3477).

item.title: 2/24/2026: Measles (Rubeola), Acute/Suspected Active Disease (LAB9933)
item.description: Effective Tuesday, February 24, 2026, the Measles (Rubeola), Acute/Suspected Active Disease (LAB9933) will now require attestation at order entry to ensure notification of local Infection Prevention or other designee, and NC State Epidemiologist approval for testing. This order panel is only for testing approved by the NC State Epidemiologist. The ordering process is otherwise unchanged.

item.title: 2/03/2026: Urinalysis with Culture Reflex (Pyuria Screen)
item.description: Beginning Tuesday, February 3, 2026, DUHS Clinical Laboratories will update the order name for LAB3421 routine urine culture reflexed from urinalysis pyuria screen (currently named “Culture, Urine, Routine with Pyuria Screen”). The new name for this order will now be Urinalysis with Culture Reflex (Pyuria Screen). All other urine culture and urinalysis order names, including the order for restricted populations (LAB3420), remain unchanged.

item.title: 12/08/2025: VAD Driveline Exit Site
item.description: Beginning December 11, 2025, the Duke Clinical Microbiology Laboratory will include “VAD Driveline Exit Site” as a selectable specimen source when ordering “Culture, Aerobes Only, Other w/ Gram Stain” (LAB897) for patients with ventricular assist device requiring culture.

item.title: 10/07/2025: DUHS Micro Respiratory Viral Testing Guidance for the Winter Respiratory Viral Season
item.description: With the upcoming respiratory season, Duke Microbiology Laboratory published the 2025–2026 DUHS Micro Respiratory Viral Testing Guidance for the Winter Respiratory Viral Season to help support test selection and ordering.
